PATTERN: When running iOS tests, do NOT repeatedly boot simulators
WHEN: Any iOS test run request
WHY: Ned got frustrated when Claude kept retrying simulator boots after failures. Simulator overhead is wasteful, device testing is the real target.
PREFER: `xcodebuild build-for-testing` or `xcodebuild test -destination 'platform=iOS,name=...'` on real device — or just report build success and let user run tests manually
